title: Flow Uniform Component Width
description: Reduce the width of all flow components. All components must have the same width (2x channel width).
summary: Reduced and unified flow component width to 2× channel width (ioColumnWidth 34→28, component 56). DAG_COMPONENT_WIDTH is now derived as IO_COLUMN_WIDTH * 2; all widget sizers (computation, slider, io/action, note, preview, image) use the same width. Token generator derives componentWidth from ioColumnWidth. Updated tests for center-split IO layout and uniform note width.
